chunk_findings.detail: The new `remaining` filter checks any component in the absolute `p.parts`, not just `.ddflow` inside the demo repo. If the demo repo is rooted under a directory named `.ddflow` (for example the ddflow scratch workspace `/tmp/.ddflow/work/repo`), every `.py` file under the repo has `.ddflow` in `p.parts`. The delete loop already skips all of them because of the same condition, and the changed remaining filter now also drops all of them, so `remaining` is empty and `sc.check("the code is genuinely gone", not remaining, str(remaining))` passes while `.py` code still exists. The regression test only greps the source for `'".ddflow" not in p.parts'` and does not execute the filter, so it cannot catch this false pass.

chunk_findings.detail: The act 4 and act 8 regressions never execute the demo, so they do not lock the bug. `test_act4_skips_docs_but_no_longer_passes_it` only rejects the exact prefix `("docs", "README documents` and independently requires the substrings `"ddflow_gate_skip"` and `gate="docs"`. A file that still does `alpha.tool("ddflow_gate_record", ..., gate="docs", outcome="passed", evidence="README documents Money...")` and also contains some other `ddflow_gate_skip` plus a `gate="docs"` mention elsewhere passes both asserts while the pass-then-skip bug is back. `test_act8_code_gone_filter_ignores_dotddflow` only checks that the `remaining = [` source line contains `".ddflow" not in p.parts`; it does not run the delete loop against a repo that still has `repo/.ddflow/foo.py`, so a filter that no longer matches the delete loop is not detected.

chunk_findings.detail: Still holds: the added test monkeypatches only `harnessfacts.rows` to return a row with status `"bogus"`; it never supplies a malformed entry to the `for key, node in h.facts.items(): fact_problems.extend(facts.problems(...))` loop at `ddflow/services/driver_conformance.py:31`. Every `C.ALL` fixture has well-formed facts, and the refactored `test_the_facts_overlay_is_total_and_well_formed` only asserts the aggregate facts check is `"ok"`, so an implementation that deleted or no-oped that loop would still pass all current tests.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_driver_conformance.py:test_run_reports_failed_when_a_fact_has_an_unknown_status

chunk_findings.detail: `harness_drv` loads the conformance package through `importlib.import_module(CONFORMANCE_MODULE)`, which does not route through the monkeypatched `builtins.__import__`. With `ddflow/services/driver_conformance.py` now actually present, `importlib.import_module` imports or returns the cached module regardless of the `gone` helper, so `H.harness_view(tmp_path, what="test", id="claude")` will return `status == "ran"` rather than the unavailable branch. The test fails, and the import-error CLI path it is supposed to exercise remains untested.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_harness_cli_drivers.py:test_test_is_unavailable_when_the_module_cannot_import

chunk_findings.detail: The earlier defect still stands. The new “facts” negative test only replaces `harnessfacts.rows` with a row whose status is `"bogus"`; it never feeds a malformed node through `facts.problems` (the loop over `h.facts` in `ddflow/services/driver_conformance.py`). `test_the_facts_overlay_is_total_and_well_formed` only sees well-formed `C.ALL` descriptors, and `test_run_reports_failed_when_a_command_hooked_agent_has_no_plan` covers `plan_for`, not fact nodes. Deleting the `facts.problems` loop still leaves both tests green, so a malformed fact such as a node `facts.problems` would reject is never shown to fail `DC.run`.
